cards.title: Big task? No problem.
cards.dek: Hand it something too big for one sitting. An architect reads your repository, decides what the work actually is, and a roster of agents runs the pieces in parallel while you watch the board.

cards.title: Give your app a design system it actually follows
cards.dek: The agent reads the UI you already have, pulls out the colours and spacing you keep repeating by hand, writes them down as tokens — then fails the build when something drifts.

go.prompt: Read the UI this repository already has, pull out the colours and spacing it repeats by hand, and write them down as a design-system bundle the build can check.
